findings_addressed.finding: CUDA timing finalization could mask the original failure and omit its cost scope.
findings_addressed.minimal_fix: Always append wall/CPU/cost evidence, retain timing failure, preserve the original exception or fail on timing failure.

findings_addressed.finding: Final per-fit cleanup can invalidate a returned success state.
findings_addressed.minimal_fix: Read final RESULT/COMPLETE and reject failed cleanup; retain partial failed-fit records and failed cohort completion.

findings_addressed.finding: Absolute process CPU counters can double-count previous fits/setup when interpreted as per-fit costs.
findings_addressed.minimal_fix: Capture initial_usage at fit entry and report CPU deltas; preserve explicitly cumulative RSS.

grouped_adapter_fidelity.jacobian_limits: Gamma=0 initially nulls Q/K/V predictor gradients. First projection rows for exactly zero removed channels can have zero probe Jacobian. Later cross-channel LayerNorm/semantic mixing can retain probe dependence; site activity is conditional and requires actual native qualification.
grouped_adapter_fidelity.ownership: Every native slow Parameter remains the same shared object via deepcopy memo; modules and every registered buffer, including task BatchNorm, are copied per member. No registered buffer is shared. Private factors are disjoint and native parameter names persist; no optimizer/reset/placement alteration is added.
grouped_adapter_fidelity.restore_limit: Bank selected restore must preflight equal duplicated slow state entries, then load distinct factors/buffers and owned optimizer/scaler/RNG state and reverify ownership.
grouped_adapter_fidelity.shape_and_unit: Native grouped W[C,cin,cout], sorted feature then sorted label namespaces, native H-major concat indexing; one actual native affine forward; bias remains outside s; unit factors preserve the native operation in real arithmetic; effective factors follow activation/output AMP dtype.
grouped_adapter_fidelity.view_limit: Adapter provides no source-view builder or state-restoring callback. Native semantic_fusion ignores the external mask. Actual family absence must cover all dependent feature and TRAIN-label paths while retaining keys/order/shapes and movie-own input; it is a precomputed semantic-channel operation, not learned per-edge geometry.

native_fidelity.RNG_and_restore: Consumes original seeded global NumPy role shuffle; train DataLoader generator=None; prebuilt known-role eval lists avoid extra loader draws; native eval FP32; preserves Python/NumPy/Torch CPU/CUDA streams; one master scaler across seed loop; separate owned selected replay with exact model/buffer/Adam/scaler state.
native_fidelity.author_math: Model bytes are exact; six seed/evaluator/count/feature-propagation/label-propagation/train helper bodies have identical ASTs.
native_fidelity.inputs_and_TEST: RoleData opens only node.dat/link.dat/label.dat. Native TEST-opening constructor, check_acc, TEST scorer/export and unassigned prediction path are absent. Unassigned targets are NaN, not negative truth. Full transductive graph/features are retained.
native_fidelity.labels_and_channels: All 25 feature and 12 label paths, dense keyword identity, destination-row/source-column relations and native row normalization are retained. Label source writes TRAIN rows only; remove_diag precedes propagation multiplication without renormalization.
native_fidelity.public_dispatch: Native public reference constructs the exact author class and installs no bank/adapter; grouped/source-supply fitting is a separate future integration.
native_fidelity.selection: Exact 200-epoch zero-based native loop, strict minimum complete VALID BCE with earliest ties, epoch-best_epoch>50, native mean BCE/AMP/Adam and five-logit task structure.

remaining_required_qualification: Root separately verifies actual DGL/Torch/SparseTensor runtime/provider compatibility and complete native full-task update/selected-state serving; this audit imports none of them.
Real M1 unit/native output and slow-gradient materiality, M4 streamed own-update/physical ownership, dose and full-scope time/memory require real-native qualification.
